author: Reign Amurao
title: Cade Cunningham's 45-Point Fury Sparks Hope as Star Vows All-Out Fight to Save Season - NewsBreak
text:
By Reign Amurao ,
1 hours ago Cade Cunningham led the Detroit Pistons past the Orlando Magic in Game 5 on Wednesday, 116-109 . Cunningham gave it his all and posted 45 points on 13-for-23 shooting from the field. He also had four rebounds and five assists. The outstanding performance from the All-Star point guard gave the rest of the team the determination to fight back and keep their season alive , as the Magic lead the series, 3-2.
He had help from veteran forward Tobias Harris, who had his third-straight 20-point game of the series. Harris had 23 points, eight rebounds and two steals. Aside from Cunningham, the Pistons forward was the only player to reach the 20-point mark.
After the contest, Cade Cunningham spoke about giving the team hope of not giving up, and addressed his mentality coming into Game 5.
“Just wanted to have a controlled aggression all night… I don’t want the season to end right now, so I gotta put it all on the line.” Cunningham said.
Coming into Wednesday’s bout, there was a significant amount of pressure on Cunningham and the Pistons. Their backs were against the wall, and their season could’ve ended. However, the star guard took charge of the game and embraced being in the big moments.
“Not everybody is blessed with those types of opportunities to have pressure, and have things on the line. A lot of times I feel undeserving of how great of moments I get to be a part of,” he said .
Cunningham said that he’s thankful for being in those moments and that the Pistons rely on him to lead them.
Ausar Thompson Had a High Praise for Cade Cunningham This season, Cade Cunningham has proven that he should be considered as one of the best rising stars in the NBA. His 45-point performance was more than enough to show what he can do during important moments when the Pistons need him.
After the game, Ausar Thompson spoke highly of his star teammate. When asked by former NBA star Dirk Nowitzki what he saw from Cunningham, Thompson said, “greatness.” He went on to praise the two-time All-Star and said that what he did against the Magic in Game 5 was not a surprise.
Game 6 will be at the Kia Center on Friday , and the Pistons will try to force a Game 7.
